Three threads cross this unit's own opening seam: שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֔שׁ תְּהִלָּת֖וֹ (oshb:Isa.42.10, tier: byte) takes up וַֽחֲדָשׁוֹת֙ אֲנִ֣י מַגִּ֔יד (oshb:Isa.42.9, tier: byte) at stem level, the attested tokens themselves returning tier NONE; the praise-noun runs from וּתְהִלָּתִ֖י (oshb:Isa.42.8, tier: byte) into תְּהִלָּת֖וֹ (oshb:Isa.42.10, tier: byte) and וּתְהִלָּת֖וֹ בָּאִיִּ֥ים יַגִּֽידוּ (oshb:Isa.42.12, tier: byte), the later pair re-collating at skeleton tier (sweep: 3 verses, the tehillah noun in ch 42); and the glory-noun runs from וּכְבוֹדִי֙ (oshb:Isa.42.8, tier: byte) into כָּב֑וֹד (oshb:Isa.42.12, tier: byte) (sweep: 2 verses, the kavod noun). None of the three rises above a skeleton- or stem-level thread; the tier-1 form shift from the first-person divine speech before it to this unit's own third-person imperative hymn-call, corroborated by the parashah marks on both edges, is what the high confidence here continues to rest on.
